evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Championing reliability and efficiency through comprehensive monitoring, automated data quality checks, alerting on data SLAs, and cost-performance optimisation.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeatedly emphasize reliability, monitoring, data quality checks, and SLAs with no velocity/speed language present, placing this at rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Powering real-time threat detection by building resilient, high-throughput pipelines that turn massive, high-velocity security log streams into signals our detection and response capability can act on in near real time
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role directly powers security threat detection and incident response at scale, a security-critical, high-consequence domain even without formal financial-regulatory language, placing this at high.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The JD describes an established 'Security Insights team' within a larger 'Security & Trust supergroup' with existing Snowflake warehouse, semantic layer, and board-level security reporting already in place, indicating a mature, specialized organization.
evidence.jd_authorship: designing clean, well-modelled, governed datasets in our Snowflake warehouse and semantic layer that act as a single, trustworthy source of truth for security metrics
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise technical scope (petabyte-scale security data, dbt, Kafka, streaming and batch pipelines, UGC entitlement/access patterns) that shows exactly what the role does day to day, written by someone close to the work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Enabling security teams to make informed decisions with data - partnering with Security Engineers, Platform and Product to build data solutions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on building the internal data infrastructure and semantic layer that security teams and internal stakeholders consume, an internal-data orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: giving teams the right insight at the right time to drive strategic decisions and incident response
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines building foundational AI-ready data infrastructure and unlocking advanced strategic use cases (strategic-leaning) with responding to specific security engineering needs and building alerting for defined SLAs (execution), making this mixed.
evidence.ai_role: Building AI-ready data infrastructure on the semantic layer... This is the foundation that downstream analytics, board-level security reporting and AI-powered tooling are built on
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build the semantic/data infrastructure that downstream AI-powered tooling consumes, the defining signal of ai_enabler, though there's also a secondary ai_user component (using AI tooling to build pipelines faster).
evidence.testing_framing: Championing reliability and efficiency through comprehensive monitoring, automated data quality checks, alerting on data SLAs, and cost-performance optimisation.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality checks and SLA alerting are framed as an owned responsibility with explicit ownership language (championing), not just tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: reliability and clear definitions matter enormously... You care deeply about data reliability, cost efficiency, and observability in security contexts
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability, trustworthiness, and security-context risk framing dominate throughout the JD ('keeps millions of users secure', 'protecting our systems and users at scale'), placing this at high.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Building AI-ready data infrastructure on the semantic layer - designing clean, well-modelled, governed datasets... Enabling security teams to make informed decisions with data - partnering... to build data solutions that go beyond traditional BI dashboards
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes new-build language (building AI-ready infrastructure, unlocking advanced use cases) with existing-pipeline maintenance/optimization (cost-performance optimisation, monitoring) roughly evenly, making this mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: Our hybrid way of working gives you the flexibility to work remotely, and to come together on campus for meaningful in-person collaboration
